peek: services (productcatalog, currency, cart, recommendation, shipping, checkout, ad), so STRICT ...

# Require mutual TLS (STRICT mode) for all workloads in the frontend namespace.
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: PeerAuthentication
metadata:
  name: frontend-mtls
  namespace: frontend
spec:
  mtls:
    mode: STRICT
---
# Ensure the frontend keeps calling the other services in the mesh with mTLS.
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: DestinationRule
metadata:
  name: frontend-mtls
  namespace: frontend
spec:
  host: "*.local"
  trafficPolicy:
    tls:
      mode: ISTIO_MUTUAL
